name: Checkbox
summary: A checkbox is a native input for an independent yes or no. Use one on its own for a single opt-in, or a set in a fieldset when the answers combine. Every box is its own tab stop, and a tri-state parent needs a script, because indeterminate is a property with no attribute behind it.
demoNote: Tab through a set: every box is its own stop and the arrow keys do nothing, which is correct — any combination is allowed. Toggle one box under Email notifications and the parent announces "mixed".

contract.useWhen: An independent yes or no, or a set where any combination is allowed.
keyboard: native: one stop per box — unlike radios, the arrows do nothing
failureModes: the drawn box replacing the input instead of sitting over it, so nothing is focusable
display:none or visibility:hidden on the real input, which removes keyboard access
indeterminate written as an attribute — it exists only as a JS property
related boxes with no fieldset and legend, so the question is never announced
api: AC.createCheckbox(root, options) -> { state, refresh, element, destroy }
